name: com.jadedbelles.util
description: Reusable Unity utilities for JadedBelles games, including grids, events, state machines, character customization, AI senses, and versioned local save systems.

samples.description: A minimal example that creates a GridSystem2D, sets values, and prints them.
Prefab + wiring reference for the CharacterCustomization module. Drop into a scene, add a CharacterCustomization rig, and go.
Generic versioned saves with detached DTOs, ID-based world graphs, async writes, migrations, and conservative backup recovery.
